description.text: Gym Official (ジム☆オフィシャル) was the name of the open events of Japan's Official Pokémon Card Gyms (ポケモンカードジムオフィシャル), game and hobby shops that hosted the card game's local official play from October 2000, for players of every level: teaching for beginners, knockout battles among the players who came, and a lottery for those who bought cards there. Some of them gave out cards of their own, in exchange for a magazine ticket or a CoroCoro Comic mount, or from a trading corner.
